Assalam-o-Alaikum! Welcome to pak Vet Vlog 
Ever wondered what a day in the life of a rural veterinary practitioner in Pakistan looks like? On this channel, I take you along on my daily journeys—riding out to farms, handling emergency cases, and working directly with the incredible livestock that powers our country.
From the challenges of field treatment to the rewarding moments of helping a sick animal or handling dairy farm management, I share it all raw and uncut.
Subscribe to join our growing community of animal lovers and farmers. Let's learn, grow, and improve animal care together across Pakistan! 🇵🇰❤️
